_comment: A binding pack authored by the Unity leg, in the engine-neutral 'insimul-binding-pack' interchange format (US-GB1 cross-engine round-trip). Asset refs use Unity-style GUID/path strings on purpose: the pack schema (format/version/name/priority/entries[{key,scene,mesh,transform,sockets}]) is identical across engines; only the asset-ref STRING values differ. The Godot importer must parse this unchanged and re-serialize it byte-identically (sorted, canonical) on export.
name: unity-core
